correctness.rationale: Reconstructed from exact 9235-byte RESULT.md with five framings in Belmans-Reineke Theorem B. Indivisible stable isotropic δ admits universal stable family over S_t=P1 minus t exceptional regular parameters; distinct stable summands have Hom=0 and Ext1=0 (Euler form <δ,δ>=0 and simple stable Hom vanishing). Framed moduli quotient of nonzero framing components yields product_i P(pr_i^*E) over ordered U_k, not merely geometric fiber equality. For t>=1 the punctured affine P1 coordinate ring is a localization of C[z], PID, so rank-two E is trivial. For t=0 the two-arrow Kronecker universal vertex line bundles differ by O(1), giving E=L⊕L for type (a), and E=O⊕O(1) up to common twist for type (b). On U_k=F_k(P1), divisor-localization Picard presentation Z^k/<e_i+e_j> yields Pic(U2)=Z and Pic(Uk>=3)=Z/2, every e_i nondivisible by 2. Thus a trivial P(O⊕pr_i^*O(1)) would imply determinant e_i=2[L], impossible; the product cannot trivialize since Aut((P1)^k)=PGL2^k semidirect S_k and connected base fixes permutation. Connected ordered configuration cover has full S_k Galois monodromy on ruling factors. Independent exact Smith-normal-form relation-matrix calculations for k=2..10 agree, but the proof for all k is algebraic. No statement about singular fibers, unordered Brauer class, or all discriminant strata.

value.rationale: The generic geometric fiber type (P1)^k alone cannot tell whether the family globally trivializes. The uniform classification over all five infinite Fano series singles out one persistent nontrivial Kronecker twist using a natural integral Picard obstruction and gives full ruling monodromy. This is a meaningful geometric topological refinement of a known local-fiber theorem, not rebranding of P1^k.
